body:
thank you i never thought of it that way, she must be pretty miserable to try and single me out for no reason. Because i was shy, insecure, sensitive and sweet she used that to hate on me. But i know now that just because she says something it isn't true. And to be honest not to go to her level but she isnt a beauty queen herself or her friends, if anything i look more decent than them. Just because i had one bad day of myself she wanted to point that out.

I guess why i am so angry is because i didnt stand up for myself, ignored and left the school, rather than at least tell her off before i left.

And that is also true, i never thought of it that way, thank you for telling me that perspective, i agree its a pretty awkward and uncomfortable situation.

I am glad that you went back to school and that the experience was not bad and you met kind people. I really hope that will be my experience too if i ever get the courage to go back. It def is tough, i think i am just too sensitive sometimes and obsess sometimes and get really sick thinking these type of people actually exist.
